text: Course InformationThis program aims at cultivating students to possess good foundation of mathematics and basic engineering theory, to have the ability of conducting the designing, manufacturing, maintenance and repairing aircraft and engine, to be qualified to work as the advanced technicians in the future in the field of aeronautical and mechanical engineering industries. The main courses in this program consists of higher mathematics, engineering mechanics, fluid mechanics, engineering thermodynamics, mechanical principles and design, design of aircraft, aero engine, design of aircraft controlling system, the basic and application of finite mega, aeronautical manufacturing technology.
